headlines.headline: CIBC Reports June Mortgage Renewals: 68% See Payment Increase, Average +$420/mo
headlines.driver: For ZEB.TO: Negative quant driver — $420/mo shock on 68% of renewals quantifies the renewal cliff that lifts PCL on performing loans (RBC 36 bps, BMO 0.56%). Directly links household cash-flow squeeze to ZEB's earnings risk, but also shows borrowers have equity to absorb — losses stay 7 bps, so ZEB trades on provision trajectory, not default wave.

headlines.headline: HFIN Rebalances: Shifts Weight to RY/TD on Momentum, Trims BNS
headlines.driver: For ZEB.TO: Neutral — HFIN's active tilt to RY/TD explains why HFIN outperformed ZEB (equal-weight) in July; comparison highlights ZEB's virtue: no momentum chase, pure equal-weight beta is more defensive if RY/TD mean-revert. Useful for ZEB vs HFIN relative value, not absolute direction.
